summary: Events, recurrence, alarms, ICS import/export and reminders exist inside the shell and the Calendar and Reminders apps. Apps with the calendars permission can read events in a date range through the calendar service (springboard/sdk/src/calendar.rs); there is no write API, no recurrence expansion and no access prompt yet.

features.note: Read side: the calendar service answers access (authorized when the manifest declares calendars, else denied) and events in a [start, end) range, from the shared store (springboard/src/shell/calendar/store.rs, appdata/is.olibuijr.calendar.desktop/events.tsv); SDK calendar::access / events / decode_events. Not yet: EKEventStore writes, a permission prompt (the manifest is the grant), recurrence expansion in the service, and Midget testing (host unit tests only)
title, location, notes, date, duration, all-day; titles capped at 160 chars; no URL, availability or structured attendees

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/reminders-desktop/src/model.rs; wired: springboard/apps/reminders-desktop/src/model.rs (tags_in, tag_counts, View::Tag); src/chrome.rs (Tags section in lists_source, sidebar_target); src/app.rs (Target::Tag); src/view.rs (list title)
features.note: app-internal file store (store.rs); no SDK access Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity.
ICS import/export and colour plates; no account sources (CalDAV, Exchange) in the store model

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/conference.rs; wired: springboard/ui/src/calendar_participant.rs; springboard/apps/calendar-desktop/src/calendar/invitees.rs (editor row Target::Invitees in src/calendar.rs)

RRULE subset FREQ, INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYDAY, BYMONTHDAY, BYMONTH, EXDATE; app-internal, not SDK; reminders have own repeat.rs
relative-offset alerts posted as notifications; no absolute or proximity alarms

gaps: No SDK calendar write API or reminder API for apps
No calendar access prompt; the calendars manifest permission is the only grant
Calendar service returns base events only; recurring events are not expanded per date
No attendees, invitations or account sources
